start.text: Welcome to Hyggeland! Follow the yellow arrows — showroom first, café, then the self-serve aisle where you pick up the boxes yourself. Tills at the end. No shortcuts, the arrows are the law.

delivery.text: Delivery is ₹1,499, next Thursday... maybe. Most people carry it on the metro. Three boxes is comfortable. Four if you are brave. Five, the guard stops you.

again.text: Arrows, then aisle, then tills. You'll be fine. Probably.
